DeclineRequest.description:
Close a run whose turn ended with nothing worth learning.

The terminal counterpart to observe/reinforce. A host that resolves and then
finds the turn not worth learning from must say so rather than going silent:
silence is indistinguishable from a host that broke, and that ambiguity is
what makes a loop-closure alert uninterpretable.

Declining does not add the episode to the corpus. It records the run as
closed, attributes it to a host, and settles the resolve reservation.

agent_name.description: Human-readable agent name, unique within your tenant. This is not the hosted agent UUID used in `/agents/{agent_id}` REST paths. If no agent with this name exists yet, a write-scoped call (`agents:write`) creates a minimal learning agent in your tenant. `POST /resolve` with only `agents:read` looks up an existing name and does not insert. Reuse the same name on resolve, observe, reinforce, and distill to target the same learning corpus. Clients conventionally namespace an agent-loop `run_id` as `<agent_name>:...`; if yours does, avoid the name `distill`, because `distill:` is reserved for corpus distillation run ids and every agent-loop write would be refused.
agent_name.title: Agent Name

is_delivered.description: Whether the recall was actually delivered to the model this turn. A turn can receive the injection and still decline, so this decides whether the resolve is billed or released: the caller is charged for recall it received, never for recall it never saw. Omitted means the host did not report either way, which is recorded as unknown rather than as a definite non-delivery: the credit alert separates a decline that lost credit from one that never had any to lose, and a default of false would silently file every omitting client under the second.
is_delivered.title: Is Delivered

reason.description: Why the turn had nothing worth learning from.

recall_outcome.description: Why the recall did not reach the model, when it did not, from the same closed set reinforce uses. A declined turn that was never shown its learnings is a different run from one that was shown them and did too little to be worth learning from. Sending this without `is_delivered` is enough: the flag is derived from it. Sending both with different meanings is refused.

RecallOutcome.description:
What became of a run's recall, as the client that owns the loop observed it.

A run that credits nothing has one signature at this boundary, an absent receipt,
and two causes that license opposite responses. Either the recall never reached the
model, in which case there is nothing to vouch for and the client is correct, or it
was shown and the record of it could not be read back, which is a wiring defect. The
receipt alone cannot tell them apart, so the client says which.

A closed set, like ``DeclineReason``: an unrecognised value is rejected rather than
stored, so the column stays queryable and cannot accrue junk cardinality. It is the
same set the client declares in ``hyperstruck/ide/recall.py``, and a member the
client can send and this one cannot costs that run its whole episode rather than
merely its diagnostic, because the request model forbids an unknown value. A new
member lands here first.

SupersessionReason.description:
Why an open version was closed, distinguishing update from revision.

WORLD_CHANGE: the world moved on (Katsuno-Mendelzon update); prior sources were
right, no reliability penalty. CORRECTION: a genuine conflict (revision); the
prior version's reliability interval widens. RETRACTION: withdrawn with no
replacement. REFINEMENT: narrowed to a more qualified claim.

The last three are all blameless closures the system performed on its own behalf, kept
distinct from WORLD_CHANGE so a synthesised chain is never later read as observed history.
ATTRIBUTE_MERGE: an offline merge put two keys in one class and their chains folded together.
RETROACTIVE_KEY: the adoption sweep recovered a key and ordered rows that were only ever
parallel because the key was missing. RETROACTIVE_CORROBORATION: the same, where the rows
agreed and folded into one surviving version rather than a chain.
